stories.summary: Amid opposition from architects and urban planners to Mahalaxmi Racecourse’s proposed redevelopment as part of the big-ticket Central Park project, BMC has decided to scrap all underground construction below the iconic landmark. stories.summary: (Representative Image) Mumbai: Observing that members of a Chembur housing society have been left in the lurch for nearly 15 years after vacating their homes for redevelopment, the Bombay High Court has said they cannot be made to wait indefinitely for the outcome of prolonged legal proceedings.

stories.summary: Mumbai ’s Powai Lake is set to become a major tourist attraction with the introduction of a ₹30-crore musical fountain and multimedia light-and-sound show celebrating the history of the Maratha Empire and the legacy of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj. stories.title: BMC drops underground development at Mahalaxmi Racecourse

stories.title: BMC To Replace 400 Damaged Manhole Covers Across Mumbai At ₹1.10 Crore

stories.title: Felling of Versova trees: Why take up Coastal Road infrastructure work away from sea, asks Congress neta

stories.summary: A financial disclosure that initially resulted in a father’s monthly child support payment being less than $700 became the focus of a legal fight over income transparency and parental responsibility. stories.summary: Pakistan minister Musadik Masood Malik said that Pakistan would discuss the Indus Waters Treaty (IWT) only when formally invited to do so, deflecting questions on the issue from reporters in Delhi. stories.summary: A suspected Ukrainian drone strike hit a Russian warship on Sunday (November 22, 2026) at a naval base in Libya, officials said, the latest attack in the North African nation linked to the Russia-Ukraine war. stories.title: Italian jeweller and businessman Paolo Bulgari dies aged 89
stories.summary: Italian jeweller Paolo Bulgari, who helped turn his family's business into a global luxury brand, has died in Rome aged age 89. stories.summary: US Democrats have secured their largest House majority in more than three decades, winning at least 258 seats in the 435-member chamber after a closely contested North Carolina race was called in their favour. stories.title: Alcaraz outplays Zverev for first ATP Finals triumph
stories.summary: Carlos Alcaraz outplayed world number one Alexander Zverev to end his wait for a first ATP Finals title and complete a remarkable post-injury return to the sport. A season which began with Alcaraz becoming the youngest man to complete the career Grand Slam, before he was ruled out for more than four months with a wrist issue, ended with the Spaniard holding aloft another of the sport's biggest trophies.

stories.summary: Malappuram , Former Kerala State Sports Council president U Sharafali, who has been named an accused in the alleged irregularities in the proposed visit of the Lionel Messi-led Argentina football team to Keralam, on Sunday said a company that sponsored the event had invested ₹ 2 crore in his football academy.

stories.title: David Beckham hails MP tribal teen who stopped her marriage
stories.summary: Bhopal, Former England football captain and UNICEF goodwill ambassador David Beckham has praised a 17-year-old tribal girl from Madhya Pradesh's Jhabua district for standing up against her marriage and securing her right to continue education. Beckham shared the story of Heema Ninama, who belongs to the Bhil community, on his Instagram account on November 20, World Children's Day, praising her courage and determination.

stories.title: Alam takes four wickets in four balls on debut as Railways beats Saurashtra
stories.summary: Debutant Jamshed Alam’s five-wicket haul (5-38), including four wickets in four balls, powered Railways to its first win against Saurashtra in Group-B of the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy at the Daly College ground on Sunday (November 22, 2026). After Railways posted 182/5, pacer Alam struck four times in successive deliveries in the fourth over as Saurashtra slumped from 24/1 to 24/5.

stories.title: Max Verstappen wins the Las Vegas Grand Prix for the third time in four years
stories.summary: Four time Formula 1 champion Max Verstappen first held off George Russell and later Kimi Antonelli and Lando Norris on Saturday night to win a thrilling back-and-forth Las Vegas Grand Prix for the third time in four years. stories.title: Thitikul wins third title in a row at LPGA finale
stories.summary: World number two Jeeno Thitikul produced a seven-under final round of 65 to claim a third successive CME Group Tour Championship title. stories.title: Leaders Barcelona make impressive Villarreal comeback, Atletico triumph

stories.title: Camara to continue with Haas for final two races
stories.summary: F1 Correspondent in Las Vegas Published 1 hour ago Brazilian Rafael Camara will continue to race for the Haas team for the final two grands prix of the Formula 1 season. The 21-year-old, who was already signed to drive for the US-based team in 2027 , was drafted in for this month's Sao Paulo Grand Prix after Frenchman Esteban Ocon was dropped following a bust-up with team boss Ayao Komatsu.

stories.title: India post highest-ever Test total in New Zealand with 720/9 in Wellington, also break their overseas scoring record
stories.summary: The first Test between India and New Zealand in Wellington stood in stark contrast to their previous tour. In 2020, India needed four Test innings to score 722 runs; this time around, they scored 720 in just one. After the hosts batted first and scored 368, India declared at 720/9, breaking a long-standing record.

stories.title: Rishabh Pant creates history! India star climbs to all-time No. 2 in Test cricket
stories.summary: The India wicketkeeper-batter now has 108 sixes in the longest format, moving past former New Zealand captain Brendon McCullum, who finished his Test career with 107 sixes. Pant achieved the milestone during his entertaining 128 off 153 balls at the Basin Reserve in Wellington. The 28-year-old was particularly aggressive against Glenn Phillips, completing his century with a straight six before sending another delivery over extra cover.

stories.title: A 'wow' player - why Ngumoha is already a Liverpool game-changer
stories.summary: Rio Ngumoha is going to be a 'wow' player for Liverpool - and he showed everyone exactly what he is already capable of in Sunday's 4-0 win over Manchester United. He made an outstanding assist then added a fine finish, and there is much more to come. He plays without fear so he is going to score and make many more goals the same way.

stories.title: Cooper DeJean addresses DK Metcalf's ejection after Steelers WR ‘almost’ poked him in the eye
stories.summary: Pittsburgh Steelers wide receiver DK Metcalf was ejected from Sunday's game against the Philadelphia Eagles in the third quarter after being penalized for unsportsmanlike conduct. Metcalf was involved in two separate altercations against the Eagles, both involving cornerback Cooper DeJean. Speaking after the game, DeJean revealed that Metcalf "almost" poked him in the eyes and "just missed" during a second-half confrontation between the two.

stories.summary: Miley Cyrus has married her partner of four years Maxx Morando during a ceremony in Palm Springs, California. stories.title: Prime-number puzzle & fluid equations: The two math problems claimed to be solved with AI | HT Explainers

stories.summary: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) has approved prosecution against Bisleri International Pvt Ltd after a sample of its packaged drinking water was declared unsafe. While one buyer may be looking for the privacy and exclusivity of a private mansion, another may see an entire office floor as a long-term investment, a future workplace or a source of rental income.

stories.summary: The National Book Trust (NBT) and the Maharashtra government have organised the 'Mumbai Book Festival' starting on November 24 to 29 with the aim of improving the reading culture among people of all age groups . stories.title: ‘Home-sick’: Mumbai exhibition explores Himalayan medicinal plants and disappearing habitats
stories.summary: By definition, homesickness refers to the unhappiness one experiences when away from home for an extended period. However, for Garima Gupta, an artist and researcher based in New Delhi, the term takes on a more layered meaning. Through her exhibition Home-sick, currently on view at TARQ, Gupta considers sickness as both a symptom and a witness — a condition through which stories of exhaustion, displacement and care become perceptible.
